task: Make the artist page tabs (Feed/Music/Posts/Photos/Videos) URL-addressable as /artist/[slug]/[view] instead of client-only activeTab state. Navigation between views must not reload the page and must not refetch already-loaded data (no full invalidateAll). Each view's data should load lazily on first navigation to it, and stay cached once loaded (e.g. navigating away from Music and back must not refetch it).
